itens.titulo: Price Prediction: 5 Years From Now, This Could Be Nvidia Stock’s Price
itens.descricao: Price Prediction: 5 Years From Now, This Could Be Nvidia Stock’s Price Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read -       NVDA revenue doubled to $96B year over year, yet shares trade at just 17x forward earnings, roughly half typical mega-cap AI multiples.
-       Reaching $500 by 2031 requires 17% annual gains, hinging on Vera Rubin ramping at $40B per gigawatt and continued hyperscaler GPU demand.
-       FY2028 EPS estimates jumped from $12.67 to $15.68 in 90 days with 42 upward revisions and zero cuts, suggesting analysts keep underestimating NVDA.
Revenue reached $96.22 billion, up 105.85% year over year.
Data Center brought in $89.023 billion, and networking alone added $40.313 billion.
CEO Jensen Huang put it simply: "AI has reached its inflection point.
Now, compute is revenue." Even so, the stock is up only 20.86% this year.
My question is simple: can NVIDIA reach $500 by 2031?
